Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class DeviceProtocolChainCustomizer

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.DeviceProtocolChainCustomizer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProtocolChainCustomizer
public class DeviceProtocolChainCustomizer extends Object implements ProtocolChainCustomizer
Enables the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant on the protocol chain. The device authorization endpoint (POST /oauth2/device_authorization) is where the device, authenticated as a public client by its identifier alone, obtains a device code and a user code. The verification endpoint (/oauth2/device_verification) is where the signed-in user approves the device; its verification URI is the framework's default, the issuer plus the endpoint, whose GET without a code is the page of DeviceVerificationController. The verification endpoint is customized to guard its requests (DeviceVerificationRequestGuard), to hand the consent decision to the existing consent page, to answer its failures with DeviceVerificationErrorHandler and to go back to the verification page when the device was approved.
